# Checkpoint

Task: Gate the MIME suffix workaround using runtime Qt only, and clarify `version_check`'s `compiled` behavior.

Root cause: `extra_suffixes_workaround` called `version_check` without `compiled=False`, so its lower and upper bounds also depended on `QT_VERSION_STR` and `PYQT_VERSION_STR`. The utility already supported runtime-only evaluation but its `compiled` documentation was unclear. It raised `ValueError` for `compiled=True, exact=True` instead of the required `RuntimeError`.

Reproduction: Added runtime-bound test cases with compiled versions on opposite sides of 6.2.3 and 6.7.0. Before the fix, `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen pytest -q tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py -k runtime_bounds` exited 1, failing at runtime 6.2.3 and 6.7.0 as expected. Updated exception test failed before the fix with `ValueError`.

Patch: Both workaround bound checks now pass `compiled=False`; utility docstring states runtime-only behavior and the incompatible-flag error is `RuntimeError`. Existing suffix derivation remains: only upstream entries starting with `.` are treated as existing suffixes, and no suffixes are added outside the range.

Checks:
- `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen pytest -q -o addopts='' tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py -k version_check tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py -k 'version_check or suffixes_workaround'`: exit 0, 31 passed.
- `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen pytest -q -o addopts='' tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py`: exit 1, 193 passed, 2 failed. `test_qdatastream_status_count` expects four enum values but installed Qt 6.9.1 has five (`SizeLimitExceeded` is extra). `TestSavefileOpen.test_failing_flush` fails due to Qt warning `QSaveFile::commit: File (...) is not open`. Neither is in the modified logic.
- `git diff --check`: exit 0.
- Initial `rg` search was unavailable: `/bin/bash: line 1: rg: command not found`; used `grep`/`find`.

diff --git a/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py b/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py
index a04d2b8..bb60c82 100644
--- a/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py
+++ b/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py
@@ -139,7 +139,8 @@ def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):
     WORKAROUND: for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-116905
     Affected Qt versions > 6.2.2 (probably) < 6.7.0
     """
-    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) and
+            not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
         return set()
 
     suffixes = {entry for entry in upstream_mimetypes if entry.startswith(".")}
diff --git a/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py b/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py
index 5e36a90..bc47ec0 100644
--- a/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py
+++ b/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py
@@ -83,10 +83,12 @@ def version_check(version: str,
     Args:
         version: The version to check against.
         exact: if given, check with == instead of >=
-        compiled: Set to False to not check the compiled version.
+        compiled: If True, also check the compiled Qt and PyQt versions.
+            If False, compare only the runtime Qt version from qVersion().
+            Cannot be combined with exact=True.
     """
     if compiled and exact:
-        raise ValueError("Can't use compiled=True with exact=True!")
+        raise RuntimeError("Can't use compiled=True with exact=True!")
 
     parsed = utils.VersionNumber.parse(version)
     op = operator.eq if exact else operator.ge
diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
index 7eeec31..079a22e 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
@@ -81,7 +81,8 @@ def suffix_mocks(monkeypatch):
     monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions", guess)
     monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "types_map", types_map)
 
-    def version(string):
+    def version(string, compiled):
+        assert compiled is False
         if string == "6.2.3":
             return True
         if string == "6.7.0":
@@ -91,6 +92,22 @@ def suffix_mocks(monkeypatch):
     monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "version_check", version)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("runtime, compiled_qt, pyqt, expected", [
+    ("6.2.2", "6.9.0", "6.9.0", set()),
+    ("6.2.3", "6.2.2", "6.2.2", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.6.9", "6.7.0", "6.7.0", {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    ("6.7.0", "6.2.3", "6.2.3", set()),
+])
+def test_suffixes_workaround_runtime_bounds(
+    monkeypatch, runtime, compiled_qt, pyqt, expected
+):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: runtime)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "QT_VERSION_STR", compiled_qt)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "PYQT_VERSION_STR", pyqt)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions", lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"])
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg", ".png"]) == expected
+
+
 EXTRA_SUFFIXES_PARAMS = [
     (["image/jpeg"], {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
     (["image/jpeg", ".jpeg"], {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
